description: Welcome to Space Voyagers! We are a passionate, driven team competing in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge.
summary: This is a junior astronaut mission trainer which is a 3d game that helps kids that want to be an astronaut clearly understand most of the things needed for a space mission. In this game they make the decision of what to do and they choose between mars and moon and go to that planet to survive there.
details: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive 3D game designed to help children who dream of becoming astronauts understand the key aspects of a space mission. Players take on the role of an astronaut, make important mission decisions, and choose whether to explore the Moon or Mars. Through engaging gameplay, they learn about space exploration, mission planning, problem-solving, and the challenges of surviving in space.
